title: Not as sturdy as I would have liked.
text:
Not as sturdy as I would have liked.. Update: fastening pin popped out and can’t be put back in with screwdriver or Allen wrench as I screw has a star pattern. Junk now.

This works for my wife at 170 pounds but wouldn't hold my 280 pound body. She uses it for cooking as her balance and stamina has been failing lately. The assembly consists of taking it from the box and unfolding it so kudos there.

product_metadata.title: Linon Home Decor Keira Pad Back Folding Counter Stool, 24-Inch
features: Dark Brown Vinyl Padded Seat; Weight Capacity: 250 pounds
Folds for easy set up and storage
Front and rear supports provide extra stability
description: Stylish seating with the convenience of a folding counter stool. This folding stool adds an extra dash of elegance for dining or entertaining. The wood frames feature a classic padded back and a wipe clean, faux leather padded seat with the appearance of leather, and a rich merlot finish. Front and rear supports provide extra stability. The space saving stool fold for easy set up and storage. No assembly required.
